<!-- pr-reviewer: 4bfb4b5a599a805a992151cd9d60c23d1df1bb4c -->
Not mergeable now: the review of the code is clean, but the branch conflicts with main. It needs a refresh (merge of main), then a fast re-check.

**What looks good**
- The new corner and centre picks reuse the existing undoable `SetWcs` and `SetWcsCircle` commands. No new command, no ad-hoc field writes. Undo is pinned by a test.
- The picks go through the one pick rule (`feature_click::feature_at`), from the pick door in `interact.rs`. Box markers keep priority. A click on nothing stays with the pick mode.
- A vertex that no longer resolves is refused by name and queues nothing. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests.
- The refusal path reuses the #692 `centres` pick kind; `centre_selection` yields a circular `Chain` only. Correct.
- Four new tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_part_point_tests.rs`, a decision file, and the body is complete (`Changelog:`, `Fixes #1502`). The before/after screenshot pair is in the body. No snapshot goldens changed.

**Results (built locally on the PR head, not merged with main)**
- Quick gate: app suites ok in 150 s (app lib 303 tests, `plane_align`, `wcs_align`, `winding_align`), ui suites ok in 156 s (ui lib 778 tests, `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `theme_files`). 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Trial merge with `origin/main` (ebda4f2fb): CONFLICTING in two files. The green gate above is for the head as it stands, not for the merged tree.

**Requested before merge**
1. Refresh the branch: `git merge origin/main` on `issue/1502-wcs-vertices` (the contributor mode of `/resolve-conflicts`). Two files conflict:
   - `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs` — main split `vertex` into `vertex` + `vertex_with_pose` (a964ad4a3, "fix(align): resolve vertex origin in named setup pose"). Keep main's structure and take the reviewed side for visibility only. Decide which one `queue_vertex` in `crates/ui/src/wcs_circle_pick.rs` calls: `vertex` now resolves the corner through the named setup's view pose. Confirm the WCS anchor pick wants that pose, and keep `pub` on the one it calls.
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` — both sides appended `mod` lines at the end. Keep both sides.
2. Re-run the quick gate on the merged tree (the app pick suites and the ui suites), then push. This PR can then merge once the refresh is re-checked.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` is at ~5200 lines. Growth of that file is tracked elsewhere; a split is owed, not in this PR.
- The hover highlight of candidate points was dropped on purpose. A follow-up issue for it is fair if wanted.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8e8e3cd6d3d13f26bf899446fca1c3b78f95c4b0 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a delta review of the merge commit 8e8e3cd6 only. The earlier review at 4bfb4b5a stands for the rest.

What I checked
- `git show --remerge-diff` shows hand edits in two files only: `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta` says DELTA with the same two files.
- `align.rs`: main's `vertex_with_pose` is kept, and `vertex` calls it with `setup_align::view_pose`. `set_wcs.rs:157` still uses `vertex_with_pose`. Nothing from main was dropped.
- `pub fn vertex` is needed. `crates/ui/src/wcs_circle_pick.rs:88` calls `camcraft_app::pick::align::vertex`. I made it `pub(crate)` as a test. The ui crate then fails with E0603. The function only reads the world inside the app crate, so the layering is kept (ui calls an app function).
- `tests.rs`: both `mod` lines are kept (`mod review_1710_evidence;` is there, and main's lines are unchanged).

Results (local, merged state, no runner used)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: builds.
- `camcraft-ui --lib -- review_1710 wcs`: 39 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.
- `camcraft-app --lib -- pick::`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
